# SyncClip

> SyncClip is a free, browser-based online clipboard that syncs text between devices in real-time. No login, no app, no tracking. Works on Android, iOS, Windows, Mac, and Linux. Sessions expire in 24 hours and support Burn After Reading mode.

SyncClip lets you copy text on your phone and paste it on your PC in milliseconds using WebSocket-based real-time sync. No account required — just open the URL on any device and anything you type appears everywhere instantly.

## Core Features

- Real-time clipboard sync across all devices via WebSockets (<100ms latency)
- Zero login or account required — anonymous session pairing
- Burn After Reading mode — data self-destructs after access
- Session locking — make all other devices read-only
- QR code pairing for instant device connection
- CMD+K command palette for keyboard-first control
- Sessions auto-expire in 24 hours
- Works on any browser: Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge

## Technical Details

- Backend: Convex (real-time WebSocket database)
- Frontend: Next.js, React
- Deployment: Vercel
- Session storage: Ephemeral, auto-purged at 24h
- No user data stored beyond session lifetime
- RSS feed available at: https://syncclip.in/feed.xml
